flags.why: Selecting or highlighting text is the everyday sense learners are most likely to encounter today.
This sense means balsam, an aromatic plant resin, rather than tar ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%C3%B4m)).
The example treats bôm as boat-sealing tar rather than balsam.
flags.fix: Bôm này có mùi thơm. = This balsam has a pleasant smell.

flags.why: Bôn tẩu is literary vocabulary and would sound marked in ordinary casual conversation.
Cả buổi does not specify that the crying happened in the morning.
flags.fix: The child wailed loudly for hours.

flags.why: Calling a person or government bù nhìn is derogatory.
The example discusses saying the expression instead of using it to describe the action.
flags.fix: Anh ta đòi cô ấy bú cu. = He demanded that she give him a blowjob.

The example explains the local name instead of using it to refer to the animal.
